name: Gregor Kleine
original_name: グレゴール・クライン
source:
Kia's client.
[url=https://vndb.org/c20936]Jens'[/url] soccer coach. He thinks very fondly of Jens, and wants him to lead a good life as a top-league professional player. He is worried that word of Jens' promiscuous ways will find its way into the mass media's hands and cause a scandal.
